measure.measure_definition: Measured value: change in HOMA2-S from baseline to week 30; Participants; Fasting blood samples at baseline and week 30; HOMA2-S calculated using HOMA2 (version 2.2.3) from fasting blood glucose and fasting insulin; samples analyzed en bloc after the last patient visit.; Higher HOMA2-S indicates greater insulin sensitivity. Change is week 30 minus baseline. Between-group treatment effect is the mixed-model mean difference (semaglutide minus placebo). Time origin: baseline; assessment at week 30.

Measured value: change in HOMA2-B from baseline to week 30; Participants; Fasting blood samples at baseline and week 30; HOMA2-B calculated using HOMA2 (version 2.2.3) from fasting blood glucose and fasting insulin; samples analyzed en bloc after the last patient visit.; Higher HOMA2-B indicates greater β-cell function. Change is week 30 minus baseline. Between-group treatment effect is the mixed-model mean difference (semaglutide minus placebo). Time origin: baseline; assessment at week 30.

Measured value: change in HOMA-IR from baseline to week 30; Participants; Fasting blood samples at baseline and week 30; HOMA of insulin resistance based on fasting blood glucose and fasting insulin. A separate HOMA version for HOMA-IR is not reported in the supplied text (HOMA2 version 2.2.3 is specified for HOMA2-S and HOMA2-B).; Higher HOMA-IR indicates greater insulin resistance; a negative change indicates reduction. Change is week 30 minus baseline. Between-group treatment effect is the mixed-model mean difference (semaglutide minus placebo). Time origin: baseline; assessment at week 30. Specific HOMA-IR formula/version: source discrepancy retained.

population.intervention_regimen: Up to 1.0 mg/week (1.34 mg/mL formulation); Subcutaneous injection once weekly for 30 weeks; uptitrated according to manufacturer recommendations
population.population_definition: Adults aged 18–60 years with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders (ICD-10 F20, F21 or F25), receiving stable second-generation antipsychotic treatment, with prediabetes (HbA1c 39–47 mmol/mol) and overweight/obesity (BMI ≥27 kg/m²). Randomized to semaglutide; received at least one dose and had postbaseline assessments, analyzed according to assigned group. The exact HOMA mixed-model analysis population size is not reported; the complete-data counts are not substituted for the model analysis N.
population.population_name: Semaglutide modified ITT HOMA analysis population
population.population_time_frame: Trial conduct January 2022 to May 2024; baseline and postbaseline assessments including week 30
